Lemma
[Criterion for completeness of a vector field (Lemma 27.6)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0028 1. ch27:27.6\group Completeness

If $F:[0,\infty )\to [0,\infty )$ is locally Lipschitz and every solution of $u'=F(u)$ is forward complete, then a vector field $X$ on a pointed complete manifold is complete whenever $|X|(x)\le F(d(x,\widetilde O))$.
